name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.camera.id_validation.ReferredToExecutiveActivity
description: This screen shows the identity-document scan summary, including whether the front or back image passed or failed, and offers the next step. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reviewing and continuing from the document-scan outcome when this step is required.
